akhfash:5-5.t: He said: ﴿كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِن بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ﴾. This kāf may relate to His words ﴿أُوْلۤـٰئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ حَقّاً﴾ [4] ﴿كَمَآ أَخْرَجَكَ رَبُّكَ مِن بَيْتِكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ﴾. Some of the people of knowledge said: ﴿كما أخرجك ربك من بيتك بالحق﴾ [relates to] ﴿فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَصْلِحُواْ ذَاتَ بِيْنِكُمْ﴾ [1]. He annexed ﴿ذاتَ﴾ to "البَيْنِ" and made it ﴿ذاتَ﴾ (feminine) because some things are given a feminine name and some are made masculine, like "الدار" (the house) and "الحائط" (the wall): "الدار" is made feminine and "الحائط" masculine.

akhfash:7-7.t: He said: ﴿وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِحْدَى ٱلطَّائِفَتِيْنِ أَنَّهَا لَكُمْ﴾: His words ﴿أَنَّهَا﴾ are a badal (substitute) for His words ﴿إِحْدَى ٱلطَّائِفَتِيْنِ﴾. And He said ﴿غَيْرَ ذَاتِ ٱلشَّوْكَةِ﴾, using the feminine because He means "الطائفة" (the party).

akhfash:12-12.t:
He said: ﴿فَٱضْرِبُواْ فَوْقَ ٱلأَعْنَاقِ﴾; its meaning is "إِضْرِبُوا الأَعْناقِ" (strike the necks), just as you say "رأيتُ نَفْسَ زَيْدٍ" (I saw Zayd's self), meaning "Zayd".
﴿وَٱضْرِبُواْ مِنْهُمْ كُلَّ بَنَانٍ﴾: the singular of "البَنانِ" (fingertips) is "البَنَانَةُ".

akhfash:14-14.t:
He said: ﴿ذٰلِكُمْ فَذُوقُوهُ وَأَنَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ﴾. It is as though He made "ذلكم" the khabar (predicate) of a mubtadaʾ (subject), or a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is implied, so that it is as though He said "ذلِكُمْ الأَمْرُ" (that is the matter) or "الأَمْرُ ذلكم" (the matter is that). Then He said ﴿وَأَنَّ لِلْكَافِرِينَ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ﴾, i.e. "the matter is that, and this"; that is why "أَنَّ" takes fatḥa. Like that is His saying ﴿وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُوهِنُ كَيْدِ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ﴾. As for the poet's words [in the basīṭ metre, and it is the two hundred and twentieth poetic witness]:
ذاكَ وإِنِّي على جاري لَذُو حَدَبٍ * أَحنو عَلَيْهِ كما يُحْنى على الجارِ
(That [is so]; and indeed I am tender towards my neighbour, I bend over him as one bends over a neighbour.)
he gave "إِنَّ" kasra only because of the entry of the lām. The poet said [in the ṭawīl metre, and it is the two hundred and twenty-first poetic witness]:
وَأَعْلَمُ عِلْماً ليسَ بالظنِّ أَنَّه * إِذا ذَلَّ مَوْلَى المَرْءِ فَهْوَ ذَليل
وإِنَّ لِسانَ المَرْءِ ما لَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ * حَصاةٌ على عَوْراتِهِ لَدَلِيلُ
(I know with a knowledge that is no conjecture that when a man's kinsman is humbled, he himself is humbled; and that a man's tongue, unless he has good sense, is a guide to his faults.)
He gave the second one kasra because the lām comes after it. Some Arabs give it fatḥa because they are not aware that a lām comes after it. Something like that has been heard from the Arabs in His words ﴿أَفَلاَ يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِي ٱلْقُبُورِ [9] وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِي ٱلصُّدُورِ إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّخَبِيرٌ ﴾: one gave it fatḥa without having the lām in mind, and this is an ugly error.

akhfash:17-17.t: He said: ﴿وَمَا رَمَيْتَ إِذْ رَمَيْتَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَمَىٰ﴾. The Arabs say: "واللهِ ما ضَرَبْتُ غَيْرَهُ" (By Allah, I struck none but him) when it was his brother you struck; just as you say "ضَرَبَهُ الأَميرُ" (the emir struck him) when the emir did not carry out the beating himself. The like of this is frequent in the speech of the Arabs.

akhfash:25-25.t: He said: ﴿وَٱتَّقُواْ فِتْنَةً لاَّ تُصِيبَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنكُمْ خَآصَّةً﴾. His words ﴿تُصِيبَنَّ﴾ are not — and Allah knows best — an apodosis (jawāb), but a prohibition after a command; had it been an apodosis, the nūn would not have entered.

akhfash:32-32.t: He said: ﴿ٱللَّهُمَّ إِن كَانَ هَـٰذَا هُوَ ٱلْحَقَّ مِنْ عِندِكَ﴾. He put ﴿ الحقَّ﴾ in the accusative because ﴿هُوَ﴾ — and Allah knows best — has been made here a connective (ṣila) in the speech, redundant, for emphasis, like the addition of ﴿ما﴾. It is added only with every verb that cannot do without a khabar (predicate). ﴿هُوَ﴾ is not an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿هذا﴾, because if you said "رأيتُ هذا هُوَ" (I saw this, him) it would not be proper speech; this implied (pronominal) form is not an adjective of an overt noun, but it may be an adjective of a pronoun, as in His words ﴿وَلَـٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ﴾ and ﴿تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْراً وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْراً﴾, because you say "وَجَدْتُهُ هُوَ" (I found him, himself) and "أتاني هُو" (he came to me, himself), so it is an adjective [i.e. a tawkīd, emphasis]. In this sense it may also be not an adjective but redundant, as it was in the first case. And in all of this it may be treated as a noun, so that what follows it is nominative, whether what precedes it is overt or a pronoun, in a dialect of Banū Tamīm, in His words ﴿إِنْ كانَ هذا هَوَ الحَقُّ﴾ [and] ﴿ولكنْ كانُوا هُمْ الظّالِمونَ﴾ and ﴿تَجِدُوهُ عندَ اللهِ هوَ خَيْرٌ وأَعْظَمُ أَجْرا﴾, just as you say "كانُوا آباؤُهم الظالَمُون" (they were — their fathers were the wrongdoers). They made this pronoun — such as their saying "هُوَ", "هُما" and "أَنْتَ" — redundant in this place, and it was not put in positions of the adjective, only because it is a separator (faṣl) by which he wanted to make clear that what follows it is not an adjective of what precedes it; and this is not needed in a position where [the noun] has no khabar.

akhfash:34-34.t:
He said: ﴿وَمَا لَهُمْ أَلاَّ يُعَذِّبَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ﴾: ﴿أَنْ﴾ here is redundant — and Allah knows best — yet it has governed [the verb]. This has occurred in poetry; he said [in the basīṭ metre, and it is the one hundred and forty-seventh poetic witness]:
لَوْ لَمْ تَكُنْ غَطَفانٌ لا ذُنُوبَ لَها * إِلَيَّ لامَتْ ذَوُو أَحْسابِها عُمَرا
(Had Ghaṭafān had no wrongs against me, its men of noble lineage would have blamed ʿUmar.)

akhfash:35-35.t: He said: ﴿وَمَا كَانَ صَلاَتُهُمْ عِندَ ٱلْبَيْتِ إِلاَّ مُكَآءً وَتَصْدِيَةً﴾: accusative as the khabar of "كانَ".

akhfash:37-37.t: He said: ﴿لِيَمَيِّزَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخَبِيثَ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبِ﴾, deriving it from "مَيَّزَ" with doubling. Some lightened it and said ﴿ليَمِيزَ﴾, from "مازَ" "يَمِيزُ", and that is how we read.

akhfash:42-42.t:
And His words ﴿وَلَوْ تَوَاعَدتُّمْ لاَخْتَلَفْتُمْ فِي ٱلْمِيعَادِ وَلَـٰكِن لِّيَقْضِيَ ٱللَّهُ أَمْراً كَانَ مَفْعُولاً﴾: the whole of Allah's command is done, but He wanted to set out the argument against them and cut off their excuse before destroying them.
And He said ﴿إِذْ أَنتُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا﴾, and some read ﴿بالعُدْوَةِ﴾, and that is how we read; they are two dialects. [Translator's note: the two forms are printed identically in the source; the variant is presumably «بالعِدْوَةِ».] Some eloquent Arabs said ["العُدْيَةِ"], changing the wāw into yāʾ, just as yāʾ is changed into wāw in such as "شَرْوَى" and "بَلْوى"; because that is done with it in what resembles this, such as "عَصِيّ" (sticks), "أرض مَسُنِيَّةٌ" (irrigated land), and in their saying "قِنْيَة" (acquisition), since it is from "قَنَوْتُ".
And He said ﴿وَٱلرَّكْبُ أَسْفَلَ مِنكُمْ﴾, making "الأَسْفَلَ" an adverb (ẓarf); if you wish you may say ﴿أَسْفَلُ منكم﴾ if you make it [refer to] ﴿الرَكْب﴾ itself and do not make it an adverb.
And He said ﴿وَيَحْيَىٰ مَنْ حَيَّ عَن بَيِّنَةٍ﴾: he made assimilation (idghām) obligatory since it came to be in a position that requires fatḥa, so it became like the category of doubled verbs (al-taḍʿīf). When it is in a position that does not require fatḥa, it is not assimilated, as in ﴿بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِـيَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ﴾ — unless you wish to conceal it (ikhfāʾ) and have it in the measure of a vowelled letter — because [the fatḥa] is not binding on it, since you say ﴿تُحْيِي﴾ with sukūn in the nominative, and drop it in the jussive; all this prevents assimilation. Some read ﴿مَنْ حَيِيَ عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ and did not assimilate, since he does not assimilate it in the rest of these cases. This is the uglier of the two ways, because "حَيِيَ" is like "خَشِيَ": when it became like non-doubled verbs he treated the final yāʾ like the yāʾ of "خَشِيَ". And you say for the plural "قد حَيُوا" just as you say "قَدْ خَشُوا", and you do not assimilate, because the yāʾ of "خَشُوا" is weakened here. The poet said [in the ṭawīl metre, and it is the two hundred and twenty-second poetic witness]:
وَحَيٍّ حَسِبْناهُمْ فَوارِسَ كَهْمَسٍ * حَيُوا بَعْدَما ماتُوا من الدَهْرِ أَعْصُرا
(And a tribe whom we took to be the horsemen of Kahmas, who came to life after they had been dead for ages.)
Some have doubled it and left it as it was, and that is ugly. The poet said [in the majzūʾ al-kāmil metre, and it is the two hundred and twenty-third poetic witness]:
عَيُّوا بأَمْرِهِمُ كَما * عَيَّتْ بِبَيْضَتِها الحَمامَة
جَعَلَتْ لَهُ عُودَيْنِ مِنْ * نَشَمٍ وآخَرَ من ثُمَامَهْ
(They were at a loss in their affair, as the dove was at a loss with its egg: it made for it two twigs of nasham-wood and another of thumām-grass.)

akhfash:50-50.t:
He said: ﴿وَلَوْ تَرَىٰ إِذْ يَتَوَفَّى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلْمَلاۤئِكَةُ يَضْرِبُونَ وُجُوهَهُمْ وَأَدْبَارَهُمْ وَذُوقُواْ عَذَابَ ٱلْحَرِيقِ﴾: He left the khabar implied, and Allah knows best. The poet said [in the khafīf metre, and it is the one hundred and thirty-first poetic witness]:
إِنْ يَكُنْ طِبَّكِ الدَّلالُ فَلَوْفِي * سالِفِ الدَّهْرِ والسنينَ الخَوالي
(If coyness is your habit — then had it been in bygone times and years past …)
By his words "فَلَوِفي سالِفِ الدَهْرِ" he means to say: "had it been in bygone times, it would have been such-and-such", and he omitted all of this speech.

akhfash:61-61.t: He said: ﴿وَإِن جَنَحُواْ لِلسَّلْمِ فَٱجْنَحْ لَهَا﴾: He made "السَّلْمَ" feminine; it is "الصُلْح" (peace), and it is a dialect of the people of the Ḥijāz; the dialect of the Arabs is with kasra.

akhfash:62-62.t: He said: ﴿فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ ٱللَّهُ﴾, because "حسبَك" is a noun.

akhfash:72-72.t: He said: ﴿مَا لَكُمْ مِّن وَلاَيَتِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ﴾: this is with respect to alliance (walāʾ). As for authority, it is "الوِلايَة"; and I know of the kasra of the wāw in the other only as a dialect.

akhfash:75-75.t: He said: ﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ مِن بَعْدُ وَهَاجَرُواْ وَجَاهَدُواْ مَعَكُمْ فَأُوْلَـٰئِكَ مِنكُمْ﴾: He introduced the khabar with fāʾ, just as you say "الذي يَأْتِيني فَلَه دِرْهَمان" (whoever comes to me shall have two dirhams); the fāʾ is attached because it has taken on the sense of a conditional (mujāzāt).

daas-irab:40-40.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction and إن is conditional. ﴿تَوَلَّوْا﴾ a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm), and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is initial (ibtidāʾiyya) and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَاعْلَمُوا﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿أَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿مَوْلاكُمْ﴾ its khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿نِعْمَ﴾ a past verb for expressing praise. ﴿الْمَوْلى﴾ fāʿil; the one specified for praise is omitted, its implied form being "هو"; the clause of praise is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), and the implied clause "وهو نعم المولى" is resumptive. ﴿وَنِعْمَ النَّصِيرُ﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one.

daas-irab:41-41.t:
﴿وَاعْلَمُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf).
﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿إِنْ﴾ here; the word in the verse is أَنَّ (in ﴿أَنَّما﴾).] ﴿ما﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as its noun. ﴿غَنِمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, and the referring pronoun is omitted, i.e. "ما غنمتموه". ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from this referring pronoun. ﴿فَأَنَّ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, because of the resemblance to a condition contained in the relative noun. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. [Translator's note: the source again prints ﴿إِنْ﴾; the word meant is أَنَّ in ﴿فَأَنَّ﴾.] ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); أنّ with its noun and its khabar is in the position of nominative as the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "فحكمه أن الله خمسه". [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿اللَّهُ﴾; the analysis "preposition and its genitive noun" refers to لِلَّهِ in the verse.]
﴿خُمُسَهُ﴾ the noun of إنّ. [Translator's note: as written in the source; it is the noun of أنّ.] This nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of ﴿أَنَّما غَنِمْتُمْ﴾.. and أنّ with what follows it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا. ﴿وَلِلرَّسُولِ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَلِذِي﴾ a genitive noun (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is one of the five nouns.
﴿الْقُرْبى﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible. ﴿وَالْيَتامى وَالْمَساكِينِ وَابْنِ السَّبِيلِ﴾ conjoined nouns. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, and the tāʾ is its noun; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿آمَنْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the khabar of the defective verb.
﴿بِاللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to آمنتم; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. ﴿وَما﴾ conjoined to الله. ﴿أَنْزَلْنا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿عَلى عَبْدِنا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ an adverb of time, also attached to the verb. ﴿الْفُرْقانِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ badal (substitute). The verbal clause ﴿الْتَقَى الْجَمْعانِ﴾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿عَلى كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar; the clause is resumptive. ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿قَدِيرٌ﴾ khabar.

daas-irab:42-42.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb for past time, a badal (substitute) from the preceding adverb يوم. ﴿أَنْتُمْ﴾ a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِالْعُدْوَةِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ an adjective (ṣifa), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَهُمْ بِالْعُدْوَةِ الْقُصْوى﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿وَالرَّكْبُ﴾ mubtadaʾ, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿أَسْفَلَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to its omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَلَوْ﴾ a conditional particle, and the wāw is for resumption. ﴿تَواعَدْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿لَاخْتَلَفْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْمِيعادِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿وَلكِنْ﴾ a particle of rectification (istidrāk). The wāw is a conjunction. ﴿لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْراً﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The interpreted maṣdar formed from the verb and the latent أن after the lām of cause is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being "قدّر الله".. ﴿كانَ مَفْعُولًا﴾ كان and its khabar, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿لِيَهْلِكَ﴾ the interpreted maṣdar is a badal from the maṣdar of ليقضي, or attached to مفعولا. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as fāʿil, and the clause هلك is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿عَنْ بَيِّنَةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿وَيَحْيى مَنْ حَيَّ﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿وَإِنَّ اللَّهَ لَسَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:43-43.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ a second badal (substitute) from يوم in His words يوم الفرقان; or an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) His word سميع or عليم.. ﴿يُرِيكَهُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the kāf is an attached pronoun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The hāʾ is the second mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي مَنامِكَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ the third mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَلَوْ أَراكَهُمْ كَثِيراً﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لَفَشِلْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is its fāʿil and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the lām occurs in the apodosis, so the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. The clause ﴿وَلَتَنازَعْتُمْ﴾ is conjoined. ﴿فِي الْأَمْرِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ لكنّ and its noun, and the clause ﴿سَلَّمَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنَّهُ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar. ﴿بِذاتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to عليم. ﴿الصُّدُورِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿يُرِيكُمُوهُمْ﴾ يريكم is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness.
The kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the plural, its ḍamma having been lengthened into a wāw; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of accusative as a second mafʿūl bihi. ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿الْتَقَيْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿فِي أَعْيُنِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to قليلا. ﴿قَلِيلًا﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), because يري here is of sight, not of the mind; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيُقَلِّلُكُمْ فِي أَعْيُنِهِمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿لِيَقْضِيَ اللَّهُ أَمْراً﴾ an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يقللكم. ﴿كانَ مَفْعُولًا﴾ كان and its khabar (predicate), and its noun is omitted; the clause is an adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَإِلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ترجع. ﴿تُرْجَعُ﴾ a passive imperfect verb. ﴿الْأُمُورُ﴾ nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:45-45.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿إِذا﴾ an adverb for future time, governing its protasis in the genitive and put in the accusative by its apodosis. ﴿لَقِيتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the masculine plural. ﴿فِئَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فَاثْبُتُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿وَاذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿كَثِيراً﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿لَعَلَّكُمْ﴾ لعلّ, and the kāf is its noun, and the clause ﴿تُفْلِحُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as its khabar (predicate); the clause لعلكم.. is causal and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ﴾ an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf), and the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَلا تَنازَعُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; لا is prohibitive, and the clause is conjoined.
﴿فَتَفْشَلُوا﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, the fāʾ being a conjunction; or the fāʾ is the fāʾ of causation and تفشلوا is an imperfect verb put in the accusative by a latent أن after the fāʾ of causation, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is conjoined to an implied maṣdar before it, the implied form being "لا يكن تنازع ففشل".. ﴿وَتَذْهَبَ﴾ an accusative imperfect verb, conjoined. ﴿رِيحُكُمْ﴾ fāʿil.
﴿وَاصْبِرُوا﴾ the clause is conjoined to أطيعوا. ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ إنّ and its noun, and the adverb ﴿مَعَ﴾ is attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وَلا تَكُونُوا﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive lā, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun. ﴿كَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of genitive by the kāf; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿خَرَجُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ دِيارِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿بَطَراً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَرِئاءَ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿النَّاسِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَيَصُدُّونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَنْ سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to يصدون. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بِما﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar ﴿مُحِيطٌ﴾; the clause is resumptive. The clause ﴿يَعْمَلُونَ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun.

daas-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾ an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted verb اذكر. ﴿زَيَّنَ لَهُمُ﴾ a past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached. ﴿الشَّيْطانُ﴾ fāʿil (agent). ﴿أَعْمالَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to زين, and the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لا غالِبَ﴾ لا is the lā of generic negation. ﴿غالِبَ﴾ its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa. ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of لا.
﴿الْيَوْمَ﴾ attached to an omitted khabar. ﴿مِنَ النَّاسِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَإِنِّي جارٌ﴾ إنّ, and the yāʾ is its noun, and ﴿جارٌ﴾ is its khabar, and ﴿لَكُمُ﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun attached to جار; the clause is conjoined. ﴿فَلَمَّا﴾ adverbial, meaning "when" (ḥīniyya), and the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿تَراءَتِ﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif, which was dropped because it met, being quiescent, the tāʾ of the feminine. ﴿الْفِئَتانِ﴾ fāʿil, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the alif because it is a dual; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿نَكَصَ﴾ a past verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿عَلى عَقِبَيْهِ﴾ a genitive noun (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual, the nūn having been dropped for the construct; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿وَقالَ﴾ the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنِّي بَرِيءٌ مِنْكُمْ﴾ like إني جار لكم, and the clause is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said). ﴿إِنِّي أَرى﴾ إنّ, and the bāʾ is its noun [Translator's note: the source prints "الباء" (the bāʾ); the yāʾ of إنّي is meant.], and the verbal clause is its khabar; the nominal clause is what is said. ﴿ما لا تَرَوْنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ما is a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِنِّي أَخافُ اللَّهَ﴾ the clause أخاف is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَاللَّهُ شَدِيدُ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and شديد is the khabar. And ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾: the clause is resumptive within the scope of what is said.

daas-irab:49-49.t:
﴿إِذْ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted اذكر. ﴿يَقُولُ﴾ an imperfect verb. ﴿الْمُنافِقُونَ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ the relative noun, conjoined to المنافقون. ﴿فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar (predicate). ﴿مَرَضٌ﴾ a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun and has no grammatical position. ﴿غَرَّ﴾ a past verb. ﴿هؤُلاءِ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿دِينُهُمْ﴾ a postponed fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَمَنْ﴾ a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يَتَوَكَّلْ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb.
﴿عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause together with the apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) after the linking fāʾ.

daas-irab:50-50.t:
﴿وَلَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive, and the wāw is for resumption. ﴿تَرى﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible; the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت". ﴿إِذْ﴾ an adverb meaning "when", attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿يَتَوَفَّى﴾ like ترى. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿الْمَلائِكَةُ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿يَضْرِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿وُجُوهَهُمْ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿وَأَدْبارَهُمْ﴾ a conjoined noun. The clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَذُوقُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿عَذابَ﴾ its mafʿūl bihi. ﴿الْحَرِيقِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause وذوقوا is the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb, its implied form being "ويقولون لهم ذوقوا"..
The implied clause of what is said is conjoined. The apodosis of لو is omitted, its implied form being "لو ترى.. لرأيت أمرا عظيما" (if you could see.. you would see a tremendous thing).

daas-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). The lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِما﴾ a relative noun in the position of genitive by the bāʾ. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿قَدَّمَتْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is for the feminine. ﴿أَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ fāʿil (agent), nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ; the kāf is an attached pronoun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ أنّ, and the Name of Majesty is its noun. ﴿لَيْسَ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb. ﴿بِظَلَّامٍ﴾ the bāʾ is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. ﴿ظلام﴾ a noun genitive in form and accusative in position as the khabar of ليس. ﴿لِلْعَبِيدِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to ظلام. The noun of ليس is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, and the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ; the clause أنّ.. is conjoined.

daas-irab:52-52.t:
﴿كَدَأْبِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate), i.e. "the habit and custom of the unbelievers of Mecca is like the habit of the people of Pharaoh". ﴿آلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿فِرْعَوْنَ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa in place of the kasra because it is a diptote, on account of being a proper name and foreign. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun conjoined to آل. ﴿مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), i.e. "الذين مضوا من قبلهم". ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿بِآياتِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿فَأَخَذَهُمُ اللَّهُ﴾ a past verb, and the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and الله, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil.
﴿بِذُنُوبِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَوِيٌّ شَدِيدُ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its two khabars. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ذلِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). The lām is for distance and the kāf is for address. ﴿بِأَنَّ﴾ أنّ is a particle resembling the verb, and the bāʾ is a preposition. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun. ﴿لَمْ﴾ a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿يَكُ﴾ a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn on the nūn, which was dropped for lightening; its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مُغَيِّراً﴾ its khabar (predicate). The clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أنّ. ﴿نِعْمَةً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of مغيرا; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ with its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is resumptive. ﴿أَنْعَمَها﴾ a past verb and its mafʿūl bihi, and its fāʿil (agent) is "هو". ﴿عَلى قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to أنعمها. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition. ﴿يُغَيِّرُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a latent أن after حتى, the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ is mafʿūl bihi.
﴿بِأَنْفُسِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to مغيرا. ﴿وَأَنَّ اللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ﴾ أنّ, its noun and its two khabars; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ and what follows it is conjoined to the interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ and what follows it at the beginning of the verse.

daas-irab:54-54.t: The i'rab of the verse has preceded. ﴿وَكُلٌّ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative, i.e. "and all of them". ﴿كانُوا﴾ كان and its noun. ﴿ظالِمِينَ﴾ its khabar (predicate), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ كل. The nominal clause ﴿كُلٌّ كانُوا ظالِمِينَ﴾ is resumptive and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:55-55.t: ﴿إِنَّ شَرَّ﴾ إنّ and its noun. ﴿الدَّوَابِّ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿عِنْدَ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the elative noun (ism al-tafḍīl) شر. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿فَهُمْ﴾ a detached nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the fāʾ is a conjunction. ﴿لا يُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is causal and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:56-56.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as a badal (substitute) from الذين in the previous verse. ﴿عاهَدْتَ مِنْهُمْ﴾ a past verb, to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿ثُمَّ﴾ a conjunction. ﴿يَنْقُضُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and ﴿عَهْدَهُمْ﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فِي كُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينقضون. ﴿مَرَّةٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause ﴿لا يَتَّقُونَ﴾ is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

daas-irab:57-57.t: ﴿فَإِمَّا﴾ the fāʾ is linking, because of the resemblance of the relative noun to the condition. ﴿إما﴾ إن is a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿ما﴾ redundant (zāʾida). ﴿تَثْقَفَنَّهُمْ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa because it is joined to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the hāʾ is its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and its fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿فِي الْحَرْبِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause of the protasis is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَشَرِّدْ﴾ an imperative verb, and the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿بِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to شرد. ﴿مَنْ﴾ a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi. ﴿خَلْفَهُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿لَعَلَّهُمْ يَذَّكَّرُونَ﴾ لعلّ, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the verbal clause is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause لعلهم is causal.

daas-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وَإِمَّا تَخافَنَّ..﴾ its i'rab is that of the previous verse, and it is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿عَلى سَواءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the object of انبذ is omitted, its implied form being "انبذ عهدهم" (cast back their covenant). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ the clause is causal, and the clause لا يحب is the khabar (predicate) of إنّ.
﴿الْخائِنِينَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

daas-irab:59-59.t: ﴿وَلا﴾ the wāw is resumptive. ﴿لا﴾ prohibitive, putting the verb in the jussive. ﴿يَحْسَبَنَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of jussive (majzūm), because it is joined to the nūn of emphasis. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun, indeclinable on fatḥa, in the position of nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive, and the clause ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَبَقُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of يحسبن, and the first object is omitted, i.e. "ولا يحسبن أنفسهم سبقوا" (let them not reckon themselves to have outstripped). ﴿إِنَّهُمْ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun, and the clause ﴿لا يُعْجِزُونَ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause إنهم is resumptive.

daas-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وَأَعِدُّوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is resumptive. ﴿مَا﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿اسْتَطَعْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿مِنْ قُوَّةٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَمِنْ رِباطِ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿الْخَيْلِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿تُرْهِبُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil. ﴿بِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿عَدُوَّ﴾ mafʿūl bihi. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿وَعَدُوَّكُمْ﴾ conjoined. ﴿وَآخَرِينَ﴾ a conjoined noun, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿مِنْ دُونِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of آخرين. The verbal clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl. ﴿لا تَعْلَمُونَهُمُ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is its fāʿil, and the hāʾ is its object, and لا is negating; the clause is in the position of accusative as an adjective of آخرين. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يَعْلَمُهُمْ﴾ is the khabar (predicate); the nominal clause الله يعلمهم is resumptive. ﴿وَما﴾ ما is a conditional noun that puts the verb in the jussive, indeclinable on sukūn, in the position of accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi; the wāw is resumptive.
﴿تُنْفِقُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl. ﴿فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to تنفقوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive. ﴿يُوَفَّ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that puts the verb in the jussive and not joined to the fāʾ. The clause ﴿وَأَنْتُمْ لا تُظْلَمُونَ﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).

daas-irab:61-61.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive, and the wāw is for resumption. ﴿جَنَحُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent). ﴿لِلسَّلْمِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿فَاجْنَحْ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and an imperative verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَها﴾ are attached; its fāʿil is "أنت", and the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى اللَّهِ﴾ the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿إِنَّهُ﴾ إنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun. ﴿هُوَ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿السَّمِيعُ﴾ its first khabar (predicate). ﴿الْعَلِيمُ﴾ its second khabar. It is also permissible for هو to be a nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), ﴿السَّمِيعُ﴾ its khabar, and the nominal clause the khabar of إنّ; the nominal clause إنه هو السميع is causal and has no grammatical position.

daas-irab:62-62.t:
﴿وَإِنْ يُرِيدُوا﴾ conjoined to وإن جنحوا. ﴿أَنْ يَخْدَعُوكَ﴾ أن puts the verb in the accusative, and an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent) and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَإِنَّ حَسْبَكَ اللَّهُ﴾ the fāʾ is linking, and إنّ, its noun and its khabar (predicate); the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿هُوَ﴾ a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿الَّذِي﴾ the relative noun, its khabar; the nominal clause is resumptive.
﴿أَيَّدَكَ﴾ a past verb and mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿بِنَصْرِهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿وَبِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:63-63.t:
﴿وَأَلَّفَ﴾ a past verb to which the adverb ﴿بَيْنَ﴾ is attached. ﴿قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the hāʾ is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿لَوْ﴾ a conditional particle that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿أَنْفَقْتَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent), and the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ after it is mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿جَمِيعاً﴾ ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿ما أَلَّفْتَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِهِمْ﴾ ما is negating, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive. ﴿وَلكِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿اللَّهَ﴾ the Name of Majesty, its noun, and the clause ﴿أَلَّفَ بَيْنَهُمْ﴾ is in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿إِنَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its two khabars; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:64-64.t: ﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾ the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite noun (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, in the position of accusative by the vocative; the hāʾ is a particle of alerting with no grammatical position. ﴿النَّبِيُّ﴾ a nominative badal (substitute). ﴿حَسْبُكَ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿وَمَنِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and من is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "وحسب من اتبعك" (and the sufficiency of whoever follows you..); the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). This is preferable, in terms of meaning, to conjoining it to الله. ﴿اتَّبَعَكَ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is its object, and the fāʿil (agent) is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "هو". ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); the verbal clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.

daas-irab:65-65.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿حَرِّضِ﴾ an imperative verb. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾ its object, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a sound masculine plural. The fāʿil (agent) is "أنت". ﴿عَلَى الْقِتالِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause is initial. ﴿إِنْ يَكُنْ﴾ إن is conditional, and a defective (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of يكن.
﴿عِشْرُونَ﴾ its noun, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿صابِرُونَ﴾ a nominative adjective (ṣifa); the clause is initial. It is also possible to parse يكن as a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb and عشرون as fāʿil.. and ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ as attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from صابرون: it was an adjective of it, and when it was placed before it, it became a ḥāl. ﴿يَغْلِبُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that puts the verb in the jussive and not joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise. ﴿مِائَتَيْنِ﴾ its object, accusative, the sign of its accusative being the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿وَإِنْ يَكُنْ..﴾ its i'rab is like the preceding one. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾ أنّ, and the hāʾ is its noun, and قوم is its khabar. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أنّ with its noun and its khabar is in the position of genitive by the bāʾ, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to يغلبوا. ﴿لا يَفْقَهُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its fāʿil, and لا is negating; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective.

daas-irab:66-66.t: ﴿الْآنَ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb خفف after it. ﴿خَفَّفَ﴾ a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun عنكم are attached, and ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is resumptive. ﴿عَنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to يخفف. ﴿وَعَلِمَ﴾ a past verb. ﴿أَنَّ فِيكُمْ ضَعْفاً﴾ أنّ and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are its khabar (predicate). The clause has stood in place of the two objects of علم, and the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فَإِنْ يَكُنْ مِنْكُمْ..﴾ its i'rab is like the previous verse, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿بِإِذْنِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to يغلبوا. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). [Translator's note: the source prints ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ here; the muḍāf ilayhi meant is اللَّهِ in بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ.] ﴿اللَّهُ مَعَ الصَّابِرِينَ﴾ the clause is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive.

daas-irab:67-67.t:
﴿ما كانَ﴾ كان is a complete (tāmm) past verb meaning "to be fitting", and ما is negating. ﴿لِنَبِيٍّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb كان. It is also possible to parse كان as a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb whose noun is omitted: "ما كان الفداء لنبي" (the ransom was not for a prophet).. The clause is resumptive.
﴿أَنْ﴾ a maṣdar particle that puts the verb in the accusative. ﴿يَكُونَ﴾ a defective imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb), the sign of its accusative being the fatḥa. ﴿لَهُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿أَسْرى﴾ its noun. The interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb يكون is in the position of nominative as the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿كانَ﴾: "وما استقام لنبي كون أسرى له" (it was not fitting for a prophet that he should have captives).. ﴿حَتَّى﴾ a particle of limit and a preposition; the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of genitive by حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the complete verb كان. ﴿يُثْخِنَ﴾ an imperfect verb, accusative by a latent أن after حتى. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb يثخن.
﴿تُرِيدُونَ﴾ an imperfect verb, and the wāw is the fāʿil. ﴿عَرَضَ﴾ object. ﴿الدُّنْيا﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive, the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible. The clause is resumptive. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿يُرِيدُ الْآخِرَةَ﴾ an imperfect verb and its object; the clause is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars; the clause is conjoined or resumptive.

daas-irab:68-68.t:
﴿لَوْلا﴾ a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (ḥarf imtināʿ li-wujūd). ﴿كِتابٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb سبق. ﴿سَبَقَ﴾ a past verb; the clause is in the position of nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of كتاب, and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being "موجود" (existing); the clause is resumptive and has no grammatical position. ﴿لَمَسَّكُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the lām occurs in the apodosis, and the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that does not put the verb in the jussive.
﴿فِيما﴾ ما is a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, in the position of genitive by the preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the verb مسكم. ﴿أَخَذْتُمْ﴾ a past verb, and the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent) and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿عَذابٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿عَظِيمٌ﴾ adjective.

daas-irab:69-69.t: ﴿فَكُلُوا﴾ an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil (agent); the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ implying an omitted condition). ﴿مِمَّا﴾ ما is a relative noun in the position of genitive, and both are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿غَنِمْتُمْ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿حَلالًا﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "أكلا حلالا" (a lawful eating); or a ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿طَيِّباً﴾ adjective (ṣifa). ﴿وَاتَّقُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to فكلوا.. [Translator's note: the source says "past verb"; اتقوا here is an imperative verb.] ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its two khabars (predicates); the clause is causal.

daas-irab:70-70.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا النَّبِيُّ قُلْ﴾ its i'rab has preceded. ﴿لِمَنْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فِي أَيْدِيكُمْ﴾ a genitive noun (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the kasra implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), and the mīm is for the masculine plural; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿مِنَ الْأَسْرى﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The verbal clause is initial and has no grammatical position. ﴿إِنْ﴾ a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive. ﴿يَعْلَمِ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and ﴿اللَّهُ﴾, the Name of Majesty, is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿يُؤْتِكُمْ﴾ a jussive imperfect verb, the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); its fāʿil is "هو", and the kāf is its first object. ﴿خَيْراً﴾ its second object. ﴿مِمَّا﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to خيرا. ﴿أُخِذَ﴾ a passive past verb, and the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is "هو". ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is the ṣila of the relative noun. ﴿وَيَغْفِرْ﴾ conjoined to يؤتكم, jussive like it.
﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿وَاللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject), and غفور رحيم are two khabars (predicates); the nominal clause is resumptive. إن يعلم and what follows it is the maqūl al-qawl (what is said), and the clause يؤتكم has no grammatical position, being the apodosis of a condition that puts the verb in the jussive and not joined to the fāʾ or to إذا.

daas-irab:71-71.t: ﴿وَإِنْ﴾ إن is conditional. ﴿يُرِيدُوا﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent). ﴿خِيانَتَكَ﴾ mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the kāf is in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿فَقَدْ﴾ the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿قد﴾ a particle of affirmation (taḥqīq). ﴿خانُوا اللَّهَ﴾ a verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is mafʿūl bihi; the clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis. ﴿مِنْ﴾ a preposition. ﴿قَبْلُ﴾ an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma because it is cut off from the construct, in the position of genitive by من; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَأَمْكَنَ مِنْهُمْ﴾ the fāʾ is a conjunction, and a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun منهم are attached; the clause is conjoined. ﴿وَاللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ﴾ the Name of Majesty is mubtadaʾ (subject) and what follows it are its two khabars (predicates). The clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:72-72.t:
﴿إِنَّ﴾ a particle resembling the verb. ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of accusative as the noun of إنّ. ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَهاجَرُوا وَجاهَدُوا﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿بِأَمْوالِهِمْ وَأَنْفُسِهِمْ فِي سَبِيلِ﴾ attached to (mutaʿalliq) جاهدوا. ﴿اللَّهِ﴾ the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آوَوْا وَنَصَرُوا..﴾ the clause الذين آووا is conjoined, the clause آمنوا is the ṣila, and the clause ونصروا is conjoined. [Translator's note: so in the source; the ṣila in this phrase is آووا.] ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable on kasra, in the position of nominative as the first mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ second mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلِياءُ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of بعضهم. ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi; the nominal clause بعضهم أولياء is the khabar of أولئك, and the clause أولئك بعضهم.. is the khabar of إنّ. ﴿وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا وَلَمْ يُهاجِرُوا﴾ the clauses are conjoined. ﴿ما لَكُمْ﴾ ما is negating, without governing effect. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar of the postponed mubtadaʾ شيء. ﴿مِنْ وَلايَتِهِمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to the omitted khabar. ﴿مِنْ شَيْءٍ﴾ من is a redundant (zāʾida) preposition. شيء is a noun genitive in form and nominative in position as mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the relative noun. ﴿حَتَّى يُهاجِرُوا﴾ the interpreted maṣdar formed from the latent أن after حتى and the imperfect verb is in the position of genitive by the preposition حتى, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the negating ما, which carries the meaning of a verb, i.e. "their guardianship over them is negated".. ﴿وَإِنِ﴾ the wāw is a conjunction, and إن is conditional. ﴿اسْتَنْصَرُوكُمْ﴾ a past verb, its fāʿil and its object. ﴿فِي الدِّينِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined.
﴿فَعَلَيْكُمُ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted, fronted khabar, and the fāʾ is linking. ﴿النَّصْرُ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿إِلَّا﴾ a particle of exception. ﴿عَلى قَوْمٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted excepted (mustathnā), i.e. "إلا النصر على قوم" (except help against a people)..
﴿بَيْنَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿وَبَيْنَهُمْ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿مِيثاقٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is in the position of genitive as an adjective (ṣifa) of قوم. ﴿وَاللَّهُ﴾ the Name of Majesty, mubtadaʾ. ﴿بِما تَعْمَلُونَ﴾ ما is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and together with the imperfect verb it is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of genitive by the bāʾ; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to the khabar ﴿بَصِيرٌ﴾, and the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:73-73.t:
﴿وَالَّذِينَ﴾ a relative noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾ a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun.
﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ second mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلِياءُ﴾ its khabar (predicate). ﴿بَعْضٍ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the nominal clause بعضهم أولياء بعض is the khabar of the relative noun, and the clause ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is conjoined to the clause (الذين آووا ونصروا) in the previous verse. ﴿إِلَّا﴾ composed of إن, a conditional particle that puts the verb in the jussive, and ﴿لا﴾, the negating lā. ﴿تَفْعَلُوهُ﴾ an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its object; the clause of the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) has no grammatical position, being initial. ﴿تَكُنْ﴾ a complete (tāmm) imperfect verb, jussive because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). ﴿فِتْنَةٌ﴾ fāʿil. ﴿فِي الْأَرْضِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to (mutaʿalliq) تكن. ﴿وَفَسادٌ﴾ a conjoined noun. ﴿كَبِيرٌ﴾ adjective (ṣifa). The clause of the apodosis has no grammatical position, not being joined to the fāʾ or to the إذا of surprise.

daas-irab:74-74.t:
«وَالَّذِينَ آمَنُوا..» its i'rab is like the i'rab of verse 72. ﴿أُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿هُمُ﴾ a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).
﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ the khabar (predicate) of the demonstrative, on the view that هم is a pronoun of separation..
The nominal clause ﴿أُولئِكَ هُمُ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾ is in the position of nominative as the khabar of the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ at the beginning of the verse.
﴿حَقًّا﴾ a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). ﴿لَهُمْ﴾ the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted, fronted khabar. ﴿مَغْفِرَةٌ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿وَرِزْقٌ﴾ conjoined (maʿṭūf). ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾ adjective (ṣifa); the nominal clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:75-75.t: والذين آمنوا.. like the i'rab of the preceding one. ﴿مَعَكُمْ﴾ an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿فَأُولئِكَ﴾ a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on kasra, in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject). The fāʾ is linking, because of the resemblance to a condition contained in the relative noun. ﴿مِنْكُمْ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the nominal clause is the khabar of the relative noun. ﴿وَأُولُوا﴾ mubtadaʾ, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the wāw because it is treated like a sound masculine plural. ﴿الْأَرْحامِ﴾ muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿بَعْضُهُمْ﴾ mubtadaʾ. ﴿أَوْلى﴾ its khabar, nominative, the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because pronouncing it is impossible. ﴿بِبَعْضٍ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar أولى. The nominal clause بعضهم أولى ببعض is in the position of nominative as the khabar of أولو, and the clause is resumptive. ﴿فِي كِتابِ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to an omitted khabar: "هذا منزّل في كتاب الله" (this is sent down in the Book of Allah). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَيْءٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾ إنّ, its noun and its khabar. ﴿بِكُلِّ﴾ a preposition and its genitive noun, both attached to the khabar ﴿عَلِيمٌ﴾, and ﴿شَيْءٍ﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause is resumptive.

daas-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يَسْئَلُونَكَ﴾: an imperfect verb; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its mafʿūl (object). ﴿عَنِ الْأَنْفالِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before them. The clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿قُلِ﴾: an imperative verb, and the fāʿil is a latent (mustatir) pronoun, its implied form being "أنت", i.e. the Prophet, Allah's blessings be upon him; the clause is resumptive.
﴿الْأَنْفالِ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿لِلَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and both are attached to an omitted khabar (predicate). ﴿وَالرَّسُولِ﴾: conjoined; the clause is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl). ﴿فَاتَّقُوا﴾: the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition), and an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and its fāʿil; and الله, the Name of Majesty, is its mafʿūl. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿وَأَصْلِحُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿ذاتَ﴾: its mafʿūl. ﴿بَيْنِكُمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined.
﴿وَأَطِيعُوا اللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِنْ﴾: a jussive conditional. ﴿كُنْتُمْ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) past verb, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the tāʾ is its noun; the apodosis is omitted because what precedes indicates it..

daas-irab:2-2.t: ﴿إِنَّمَا﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿إِذا﴾: an adverb containing the meaning of condition. ﴿ذُكِرَ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb in the passive, and the Name of Majesty is its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَجِلَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition. ﴿تُلِيَتْ﴾: a past verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿عَلَيْهِمْ﴾ are attached (mutaʿalliq). ﴿آياتُهُ﴾: nāʾib fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿زادَتْهُمْ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl (object). ﴿إِيماناً﴾: tamyīz (specification). ﴿وَعَلى رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun before it are attached, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:3-3.t: ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, badal (substitute), and the verbal clause ﴿يُقِيمُونَ الصَّلاةَ﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿وَمِمَّا﴾: a relative noun in the position of the genitive governed by من. The preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بينفقون﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source, i.e. to the verb يُنْفِقُونَ.]»; the clause is conjoined, and the clause ﴿رَزَقْناهُمْ﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:4-4.t:
﴿أُولئِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the kasra, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the kāf is for address. ﴿هُمُ﴾: a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position. ﴿الْمُؤْمِنُونَ﴾: khabar (predicate); or هم is a nominative pronoun, mubtadaʾ, and المؤمنون its khabar, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك. ﴿حَقًّا﴾: a ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "المؤمنون إيمانا حقا" (the believers with a true belief).
﴿لَهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar. ﴿دَرَجاتٌ﴾: mubtadaʾ. ﴿عِنْدَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to an omitted ṣifa of درجات. ﴿رَبِّهِمْ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).. ﴿وَمَغْفِرَةٌ وَرِزْقٌ﴾: conjoined. ﴿كَرِيمٌ﴾: ṣifa.

daas-irab:5-5.t:
﴿كَما﴾: the kāf is a preposition; ما is maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun). ﴿أَخْرَجَكَ﴾: a past verb, and the kāf is its mafʿūl (object). ﴿رَبُّكَ﴾: its fāʿil (agent). ﴿مِنْ بَيْتِكَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial). The interpreted maṣdar formed from the maṣdariyya ما and the verb after it is in the position of the genitive governed by the kāf, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun).
﴿وَإِنَّ فَرِيقاً﴾: inna and its noun, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). ﴿مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa of فريقا. ﴿لَكارِهُونَ﴾: the khabar (predicate) of inna, with the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl.

daas-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يُجادِلُونَكَ فِي الْحَقِّ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached (mutaʿalliq); the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa).
﴿بَعْدَ﴾: an adverb of time attached to the verb. ﴿ما تَبَيَّنَ﴾: ما is maṣdariyya, interpreted together with the verb as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿كَأَنَّما﴾: the restraining particle and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa). ﴿يُساقُونَ﴾: an imperfect verb in the passive, to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿إِلَى الْمَوْتِ﴾ are attached. The wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial). ﴿وَهُمْ﴾: a detached pronoun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the clause ينظرون is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause ﴿وَهُمْ يَنْظُرُونَ﴾ is circumstantial.

daas-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وَإِذْ﴾: an adverb of time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied verb "اذكروا" (remember); the wāw is resumptive and the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿يَعِدُكُمُ اللَّهُ﴾: an imperfect verb; the kāf is its first object and الله, the Name of Majesty, its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِحْدَى﴾: its second object. ﴿الطَّائِفَتَيْنِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the yāʾ because it is a dual. ﴿أَنَّها﴾: anna and its noun.
﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); أن with its noun and its khabar is, by interpretation, a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute) from إحدى. ﴿وَتَوَدُّونَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is its fāʿil; the clause is in the position of the accusative as ḥāl (circumstantial) after the wāw of circumstance. ﴿أَنَّ غَيْرَ﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿ذاتِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿الشَّوْكَةِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi. ﴿تَكُونُ﴾: an incomplete (nāqiṣ) imperfect verb, and its noun is a latent (mustatir) pronoun. ﴿لَكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar; the clause is in the position of the nominative as khabar of أن, and أن with its noun and its khabar is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَيُرِيدُ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُحِقَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil, and the interpreted maṣdar is its mafʿūl. ﴿بِكَلِماتِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl. The clause is conjoined to the clause يعدكم. And likewise the clause ﴿وَيَقْطَعَ دابِرَ الْكافِرِينَ﴾ is conjoined.

daas-irab:8-8.t: ﴿لِيُحِقَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb, its implied form being: "فعل الله هذا" (Allah did this).. ﴿الْحَقُّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «[Translator's note: so in the source, with the word written with ḍamma; as object it is الْحَقَّ.]» ﴿وَيُبْطِلَ الْباطِلَ﴾: conjoined. ﴿وَلَوْ﴾: لو is the connective (waṣliyya) لو, and the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). And the clause ﴿كَرِهَ الْمُجْرِمُونَ﴾ is circumstantial.

daas-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إِذْ﴾: a badal (substitute) from وَإِذْ يَعِدُكُمُ, or attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted اذكر (remember).
﴿تَسْتَغِيثُونَ رَبَّكُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿فَاسْتَجابَ لَكُمْ﴾: a past verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿لَكُمْ﴾ are attached, and its fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is conjoined. ﴿أَنِّي﴾: anna and its noun. ﴿مُمِدُّكُمْ﴾: its khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by a preposition, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to استجاب. ﴿بِأَلْفٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the active participle ممدكم. ﴿مِنَ الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of ألف. ﴿مُرْدِفِينَ﴾: a ṣifa of ألف.

daas-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وَما﴾: negating, and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ﴾: a past verb and its mafʿūl (object), and the Name of Majesty is its fāʿil (agent). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr).
﴿بُشْرى﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose) or second mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ﴾: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of cause (lām al-taʿlīl). The interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to what precedes them. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. ﴿قُلُوبُكُمْ﴾: fāʿil. ﴿وَما﴾: ما is negating and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿النَّصْرُ﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject). ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction. ﴿مِنْ عِنْدِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted khabar (predicate); the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿اللَّهُ﴾: the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ﴾: inna, the Name of Majesty its noun and عزيز its khabar. ﴿حَكِيمٌ﴾: a second khabar; the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

daas-irab:11-11.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: a second badal (substitute) from His saying (وإذ يعدكم..). ﴿يُغَشِّيكُمُ النُّعاسَ﴾: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the yāʾ because of heaviness; its fāʿil (agent) is "هو", the kāf is its first object and النعاس its second object. ﴿أَمَنَةً﴾: mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose). ﴿مِنْهُ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣifa (adjective) of أمنة. The clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿وَيُنَزِّلُ﴾: an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir). ﴿عَلَيْكُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and likewise ﴿مِنَ السَّماءِ﴾ is also attached to the verb; the clause is conjoined. ﴿ماءً﴾: mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿لِيُطَهِّرَكُمْ﴾: the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن and the verb is in the position of the genitive governed by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ينزل. ﴿بِهِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يطهركم. ﴿وَيُذْهِبَ عَنْكُمْ رِجْزَ الشَّيْطانِ.. وَلِيَرْبِطَ عَلى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَيُثَبِّتَ بِهِ الْأَقْدامَ﴾: the clauses are conjoined.

daas-irab:12-12.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) يثبت, or a third badal (substitute). ﴿يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى الْمَلائِكَةِ﴾: an imperfect verb to which the preposition and its genitive noun are attached, and ربك is its fāʿil (agent); the clause is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa). ﴿أَنِّي مَعَكُمْ﴾: anna and its noun; معكم is an adverb of place, attached to its omitted khabar (predicate); the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, its noun and its khabar is in the position of the genitive governed by the bāʾ, or in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb يوحي. ﴿فَثَبِّتُوا﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi; the clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition, and the clause ﴿آمَنُوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿سَأُلْقِي﴾: the sīn is for the future, and an imperfect verb whose fāʿil is latent (mustatir); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فِي قُلُوبِ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb, and the relative noun ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾ is in the position of the genitive by annexation. ﴿كَفَرُوا﴾: the clause is the ṣila. ﴿الرُّعْبَ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿فَاضْرِبُوا﴾: like فثبتوا.. ﴿فَوْقَ﴾: an adverb of place, attached to the verb. ﴿الْأَعْناقِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). ﴿وَاضْرِبُوا﴾: conjoined. ﴿مِنْهُمْ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from بنان, which comes after them. The clause is conjoined. ﴿كُلَّ﴾: mafʿūl bihi. ﴿بَنانٍ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.

daas-irab:13-13.t:
«[Translator's note: the source text of this entry is damaged — the Quranic brackets are lost and the first letter of several words is missing (e.g. "لِكَ" for ذلِكَ, "ِأَنَّهُمْ" for بِأَنَّهُمْ). The intended Quranic words have been restored inside ﴿…﴾ below.]»
﴿ذلِكَ﴾: a demonstrative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); the lām is for distance and the kāf for address. ﴿بِأَنَّهُمْ﴾: anna and its noun, and the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural; and the verbal clause ﴿شَاقُّوا اللَّهَ﴾ is in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: conjoined; the interpreted maṣdar formed from أن, its noun and its khabar [with the bāʾ] is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of the mubtadaʾ, and the nominal clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ. ﴿يُشاقِقِ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and given a kasra to prevent the meeting of two sukūns; the nominal clause من يشاقق is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). ﴿اللَّهَ﴾: the Name of Majesty, mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿وَرَسُولَهُ﴾: conjoined. ﴿فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ شَدِيدُ﴾: inna, its noun and its khabar. ﴿الْعِقابِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the protasis with its apodosis is in the position of the nominative as khabar of the mubtadaʾ من.

daas-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ذلِكُمْ﴾: a demonstrative in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. "ذلكم العقاب" (that is the punishment); it may also be the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ; the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿فَذُوقُوهُ﴾: an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the deletion of the nūn, with its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the fāʾ is resumptive and the clause is resumptive. ﴿وَأَنَّ لِلْكافِرِينَ عَذابَ﴾: anna and its noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) its omitted khabar.
﴿النَّارِ﴾: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause is conjoined.

daas-irab:15-15.t:
﴿يا أَيُّهَا﴾: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative; and ها is for alerting (tanbīh). ﴿الَّذِينَ﴾: a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as badal (substitute). «[Translator's note: so in the source; الذين after أيها is usually said to be in the position of the nominative.]» ﴿آمَنُوا﴾: a past verb and fāʿil (agent); the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun. ﴿إِذا﴾: adverbial (ẓarfiyya), conditional, non-jussive. ﴿لَقِيتُمُ﴾: a past verb and fāʿil, and the mīm is for the plural; the relative noun is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause (كفروا is the ṣila. ﴿زَحْفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فَلا﴾: لا is the prohibitive لا, governing the jussive, and the fāʾ links the apodosis. ﴿تُوَلُّوهُمُ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn because it is one of the five verbs; the wāw is its fāʿil and the hāʾ its first object. ﴿الْأَدْبارَ﴾: its second object. The clause has no grammatical position, being the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.

daas-irab:16-16.t:
﴿وَمَنْ﴾: a jussive conditional noun, mubtadaʾ (subject), and the wāw is resumptive. ﴿يُوَلِّهِمْ﴾: يول is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the weak letter from its end; its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), and the hāʾ is its first object. ﴿يَوْمَئِذٍ﴾: يوم is an adverb of time annexed to an adverb of time. ﴿دُبُرَهُ﴾: its second object. ﴿إِلَّا﴾: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) or exception. ﴿مُتَحَرِّفاً﴾: ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative, or the excepted (mustathnā). ﴿لِقِتالٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) متحرفا. The nominal clause ومن.... is resumptive (mustaʾnafa), with no grammatical position. ﴿أَوْ مُتَحَيِّزاً﴾: conjoined. ﴿إِلى فِئَةٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to متحيزا. ﴿فَقَدْ﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq). ﴿باءَ﴾: a past verb. ﴿بِغَضَبٍ﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the verb. ﴿مِنَ اللَّهِ﴾: the Name of Majesty is genitive by من; both are attached to غضب; the clause is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿وَمَأْواهُ﴾: مأوى is a mubtadaʾ, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif because of impossibility; the hāʾ is an attached pronoun in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa), and the wāw is a conjunction. ﴿جَهَنَّمُ﴾: khabar (predicate). The nominal clause is conjoined. ﴿وَبِئْسَ﴾: an inflexible (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame. ﴿الْمَصِيرُ﴾: fāʿil; the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e. "مصيرهم" (their destination). The clause بئس المصير is in the position of the nominative as khabar of this omitted mubtadaʾ. And the nominal clause مصيرهم بئس المصير is resumptive.

daas-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فَلَمْ﴾: the fāʾ is resumptive. ﴿لم﴾: a particle of negation, jussive and conversion (to the past). ﴿تَقْتُلُوهُمْ﴾: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the deletion of the nūn, with its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl (object); the clause is resumptive (mustaʾnafa). ﴿وَلكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾: lākinna, and the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the verbal clause ﴿قَتَلَهُمْ﴾ is its khabar (predicate); the nominal clause ولكن الله.. is conjoined.
﴿وَما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction and ما is negating. ﴿رَمَيْتَ﴾: a past verb and its fāʿil; the clause is conjoined. ﴿إِذْ﴾: an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb before it, and the clause ﴿رَمَيْتَ﴾ after it is in the position of the genitive by annexation (iḍāfa); likewise the clause ﴿لكِنَّ اللَّهَ﴾ is conjoined.
